purpose: Independent server-authoritative authentication session for one Account; distinct from DANTE business Session.

check_constraints.name: ck_auth_session_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(authenticated_at) AND isfinite(recent_auth_at) AND isfinite(last_user_activity_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND authenticated_at >= created_at AND recent_auth_at >= authenticated_at AND last_user_activity_at >= created_at AND expires_at > authenticated_at
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_auth_session_revocation
check_constraints.expression_contract: (revoked_at IS NULL AND revocation_reason_code IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(revoked_at) AND revoked_at >= created_at AND revocation_reason_code IS NOT NULL AND revocation_reason_code = btrim(revocation_reason_code) AND revocation_reason_code <> '')
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

state_history.current_binding: Current M5 security state follows the reviewed lifecycle contract.
state_history.chronology: Timestamps encode bounded current security lifecycle rather than a general event log.
state_history.immutability_policy: Identity/ownership fields are immutable unless the M5 contract explicitly permits a bounded lifecycle update.

lifecycle.retention: Retained or purged according to the reviewed M5 durable/ephemeral lifecycle.
lifecycle.redaction: Security identifiers, provider data and verifiers are not exposed outside authorized paths.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE exists only where the M5 contract defines ephemeral consume/cleanup; durable credentials use logical revocation.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL catalog, constraint, ACL and migration proof for the M5 persistence foundation.
